verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Grafana exposing itself as an MCP server (Cloud MCP Server / open-source mcp-grafana) so external AI agents can call Grafana's tools — the opposite of the story, which asks whether Grafana can plug in and consume external MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Grafana or Grafana Assistant acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers.
